calls.title: Growthbook Edge Review
calls.summary: The team aims to integrate GrowthBook into the Cloudflare infrastructure by preferring a modular implementation to allow independent management by team members, avoiding bottlenecks in resource access. Constraints exist due to internal versus external traffic handling, particularly concerning the brighthorizons.com domain, which complicates routing decisions. Security is paramount, with Rob emphasizing the need for direct code access and thorough vetting of any code deployed on Cloudflare due to constant pen testing. The need for internal approval for external-only GrowthBook experiments was discussed, along with the importance of session integrity amid Azure's network complexities. Collaborative planning and phased implementation in non-production environments were highlighted to facilitate testing and streamline the rollout process.
calls.keywords: Cloudflare Workers, GrowthBook SDK, Edge Worker, User Bucketing, Internal vs External Routing, Security Considerations
